verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order with the headline dominant and the CTA on the right. But the SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline, the three flavour pills are stacked in a cramped column against the left edge in reversed order and are too small to read, and the subcopy and legal text are microscopic. B is worse: the CTA opens the banner on the far left, the legal fine print is as large as the headline and takes over the right side, the subcopy is gone, and the pills are scattered (Blood Orange is a tiny fragment under the CTA, Honey Rosemary and Cucumber Mint crowd each other).
